title: Register with MarylandSaves or certify a retirement plan exemption
description: Employers in business at least two calendar years with at least one employee and an automated payroll system must register or certify another qualified plan; the state notifies each employer of its date. There is no penalty, but participating or certifying waives the $300 annual report fee.
exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)
